primary_source: Ehab ElSalamouny and Sebastien Gambs, Differential Privacy Models for Location-Based Services, Transactions on Data Privacy9(2016),15-48
actual_read_scope: Opening model and Definitions1-2; targeted Section6 definition/hypothesis context and Theorem23; complete Section8 conclusion. Selected utility and circularization interfaces located by search. Not a complete34-page proof audit.
explicit_metric_restriction: Section6 says distinguishability depends only on the Euclidean distance between points, and repeats this restriction when comparing with general metric d_X-privacy. Theorem23 assumes X is a circular region; its loss is the scalar function of noise magnitude described in the utility model.
regularity_boundary: Definition1 assumes bounded densities whose discontinuities in any bounded region lie on finitely many analytic curves. This is not the original unrestricted all-Borel-law quantifier.
historical_status_only: The2016 conclusion lists identification of an optimal circular noise function for a given loss as future work, and separately proposes extending its circular-domain theorem to other domains. The2018 paper1805.09571v1 conclusion still lists(D,epsilon)-location privacy and D-restricted distinguishability functions as future directions after proving its distance-proportional geo-indistinguishability result. These historical statements are not current2026 openness certificates.
current_target_boundary: Neither read interface authenticates the full l1-diamond sensitivity/squared-Euclidean finite-V solution. Circularizing under Euclidean-distance privacy does not preserve the original anisotropic one-step shift budget by an unproved norm substitution.
prior_art_boundary: Symmetric additive noise, radial averaging when licensed by rotational hypotheses, density regulation and compactness methods are prior tools, not independently counted discoveries. NOVELTY_UNCLEAR remains for the current coupled candidate and any future matching-value result.
execution: Public primary-source reading and metadata only
